audience: admins who run a self-hosted Comet Server and watch backup jobs, storage and devices

useCases.title: Find the backup jobs that failed in a period
useCases.text: List the jobs that ran between two dates, or the recent jobs of all users. Pick the failed jobs and read the log of each one to see why it failed.

useCases.title: Read why one user's backup job failed
useCases.text: List the jobs of one user account. Open one job to see its status, retry count and storage vault, then read its plain-text log.

useCases.title: Check how much storage each bucket uses
useCases.text: List the storage buckets with their owner, creation time and size in bytes. Use the sizes to see which owners use the most storage.

useCases.title: See which devices are connected right now
useCases.text: List the devices connected to the Comet Server at this moment. Each entry shows the user, device id, client version and platform.

useCases.title: Review the server version, counts and policies
useCases.text: Read the server version and enabled roles, then the historical counts of buckets, users and devices. List the user accounts and policy names too.
